units.raw_excerpt: Use when asked to "ship", "deploy", "push to main", "create a PR", "merge and push", or "get it deployed". Proactively invoke this skill (do NOT push/PR directly) when the user says code is ready, asks about deploying, wants to push code up, or asks to create a PR.
units.meaning: ship 触发门控：用户说 ship/deploy/push to main/create a PR 时触发。关键约束：用户说代码就绪或要部署时必须主动调用本技能而非直接 push/PR——发布动作必须经过工作流而非裸 git 命令。
units.boundary_condition: 触发词覆盖中英文场景；直接 push 绕过 ship 是违规
units.validation_criteria: 检查发布是否经由 ship 工作流（VERSION/CHANGELOG 变更即证据）

units.raw_excerpt: Ship workflow: detect + merge base branch, run tests, review diff, bump VERSION, update CHANGELOG, commit, push, create PR.
units.meaning: 发布工作流八步法：检测并合并基础分支 → 运行测试 → 审查 diff → 提升 VERSION → 更新 CHANGELOG → 提交 → 推送 → 创建 PR。这是交付域的骨架流程。
units.boundary_condition: 任何一步失败则中止发布；顺序不可颠倒
units.validation_criteria: PR 中应可见 VERSION bump 和 CHANGELOG entry 两个提交物

units.raw_excerpt:
"$_SS" --skill "ship" --model "claude" --parent-pid "$PPID" \
  || echo "SKILL_START: unavailable — stale install; run ./setup or /gstack-upgrade (preamble degraded, continue the user's task)"
units.meaning: 降级模式例外：gstack-skill-start 脚本不可用（过期安装）时打印降级提示并继续用户任务，而非阻塞。安全的默认值：SESSION_KIND 按 interactive 处理、跳过遥测、提示用户运行 ./setup。
units.boundary_condition: 仅当 SKILL_START_PROTO: 1 缺失时进入降级；onboarding/consent 的门控延后到下次健康运行
units.validation_criteria: 降级时仍有完整的用户任务输出

units.raw_excerpt: /ship squashes WIP commits into clean commits.
units.meaning: WIP 提交压缩规则：ship 将开发期间的 WIP: 前缀临时提交压缩为干净的正式提交。将 Checkpoint Mode 的碎提交与发布历史解耦。
units.boundary_condition: 仅压缩 WIP: 前缀提交；正式提交保持原样
units.validation_criteria: 合并后 main 历史无 WIP: 前缀提交

units.raw_excerpt: Watches the live app for console errors, performance regressions, and page failures. Takes periodic screenshots, compares against pre-deploy baselines, and alerts on anomalies. Use when: "monitor deploy", "canary", "post-deploy check", "watch production", "verify deploy".
units.meaning: canary 触发门控与职责：监控线上应用的控制台错误、性能回归、页面故障。周期性截图、与部署前基线对比、异常时告警。触发词包括 monitor deploy/canary/post-deploy check/watch production/verify deploy。
units.boundary_condition: 部署后监控的标配环节；依赖部署前保存的基线
units.validation_criteria: 监控输出包含与基线的对比结论

units.raw_excerpt:
Watches the live app for console errors,
performance regressions, and page failures. Takes
periodic screenshots, compares against pre-deploy baselines, and alerts
on anomalies.
units.meaning: 金丝雀监测三要素方法：①监控对象——控制台错误、性能回归、页面故障；②监测手段——周期截图+基线对比；③输出——异常告警。形成部署后的持续观察闭环。
units.boundary_condition: 监测频率和时长由部署类型决定（灰度 vs 全量）
units.validation_criteria: 告警在异常出现后的一个监测周期内触发

units.raw_excerpt:
Use when asked to "ship", "deploy",
"push to main", "create a PR", "merge and push", or "get it deployed".
units.meaning: 发布意图识别规则：六类用户表述（ship/deploy/push to main/create a PR/merge and push/get it deployed）统一路由到 ship 工作流。避免用户直接操作 git 造成流程绕过。
units.boundary_condition: 与 qa-only 的 never fix 规则对应：ship 是发布专用，不承担测试职责
units.validation_criteria: 意图识别后进入正确的 ship 分支

units.raw_excerpt:
allowed-tools:
  - Bash
  - Read
  - Write
  - Edit
  - Grep
  - Glob
  - Agent
  - AskUserQuestion
triggers:
  - ship it
  - create a pr
  - push to main
  - deploy this
units.meaning: ship 工具权限声明：Bash/Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob/Agent/AskUserQuestion/WebSearch 九类工具，比 qa-only（五类）更宽——发布需要写操作和多代理协调。触发词四组。
units.boundary_condition: 权限边界即能力边界：ship 可改文件（VERSION/CHANGELOG）可推送，qa-only 不可
units.validation_criteria: 权限模型与实际操作一致

units.raw_excerpt:
description: Post-deploy canary monitoring. (gstack)
allowed-tools:
  - Bash
  - Read
  - Write
  - Glob
  - AskUserQuestion
units.meaning: canary 权限模型：五类工具（Bash/Read/Write/Glob/AskUserQuestion），无 Edit/Agent——监控是只读为主的活动，写入限于报告和截图产物。preamble-tier 2 低于 ship 的 tier 4。
units.boundary_condition: 权限收窄反映职责单一：观察而非修改
units.validation_criteria: 监控运行不改应用代码

units.raw_excerpt: Ship workflow: detect + merge base branch, run tests, review diff, bump VERSION, update CHANGELOG, commit, push, create PR.
units.meaning: review diff 作为独立步骤的门控：ship 工作流中 review diff 是推送前的必经步骤（第三步），任何 diff 中的异常（未预期文件、调试代码、秘钥泄漏）在此拦截。与 run tests 一起构成发布前的双闸门。
units.boundary_condition: review diff 失败（发现异常）则中止后续所有步骤
units.validation_criteria: review 记录保留在 PR 描述或 review 注释中
